question.text: A Category III AIF sold its overseas investment. Within how many working days must it furnish details of the sale to SEBI?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI Circular dated August 17, 2022 on overseas investment by AIFs, details of sale/divestment must be furnished within 3 working days so SEBI can update the overall overseas investment limit. The Trap: 1/7/15 working days are not the prescribed timeline.
